plex_provider_id.label: Plex Music Provider
plex_provider_id.description: Select the Plex music provider to use for this connection.

mass_player_id.label: Music Assistant Player
mass_player_id.description: Select the MA player to advertise as a Plex remote client.

player_name.label: Player Name in Plex
player_name.description: Custom name for this player as it appears in Plex apps. Leave empty to use the player's name.

device_class.label: Device Class
device_class.description: How this player appears in Plex apps.

port.label: Network Port
port.description: TCP port this player is advertised and reachable on in Plex apps. Leave empty to auto-assign a free port and remember it for this instance.

plextv_link_intro.label: If this player does not show up in the Plexamp mobile apps (iOS/Android), link it with your Plex account to register it on plex.tv. On some networks the mobile apps only list players registered on plex.tv, while desktop and web apps discover this player on the local network without linking.

plextv_linked.label: Linked with plex.tv. This player appears in the cast menu of the Plexamp mobile apps.

plextv_link_code.label: Open https://plex.tv/link (signed in to your Plex account) and enter code: {0}

plextv_status_not_confirmed.label: The code was not confirmed yet - enter it at https://plex.tv/link and try again.

plextv_status_expired.label: The link code has expired - request a new code.

start_link.label: Link with plex.tv
start_link.description: Requests a link code from plex.tv. Enter the code at plex.tv/link (while signed in to your Plex account) to register this player.

start_link_new.label: Request a new link code
start_link_new.description: Discards the current code and requests a fresh one from plex.tv.

complete_link.label: Complete linking
complete_link.description: Click this after entering the code at plex.tv/link to finish registering this player.

unlink.label: Unlink from plex.tv
unlink.description: Forget the plex.tv device token for this player. The device entry can also be removed from your Plex account's authorized devices.

user.title: Choose what to expose to Plex
user.description: Pick the Plex server this player should show up on, and the Music Assistant player to expose.

abort.no_plex_provider: No Plex music provider is loaded. Make sure your Plex provider is set up and working, then try again.
abort.no_players: No players are available yet. Add a player to Music Assistant first, then try again.

manifest.description: Makes a Music Assistant player appear as a device in the official Plex apps.
